text:
Nadia - CSM: PioneerML just surfaced an expansion signal. Their analytics team spun up a new embeddings pipeline and qps for /embed jumped ~3x this morning. Finance wants chargeback breakdowns and the security team asked about key separation. Link: https://app.redwood.dev/customers/pioneerml/usage :mag:
Eli - SE: Can you paste a 48h snapshot and which models/params they use?
Nadia - CSM: From console paste:
48h peak qps: 1400
baseline qps: 430
median tokens/req: 120
95th tokens/req: 900
routes: /embed (72%), /chat (18%), /retrieval (10%)
errors: sporadic 429s on /embed during index rebuilds
p95 embed latency: 620ms, tail up to 1.6s during cold index

Jordi - AE: Renewal in ~5 months. High intent to expand if we can provide stable latency and cost transparency. Finance asked for per-route token-cost CSV export and a clear estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted unit costs.
Rita - Infra: 429s during index rebuild implies concurrency/IO pressure. We can propose a short Dedicated trial focusing only on embeddings (2 GPUs + NVMe cache) or offer a private ingest path with dedicated KV caching. Need their expected daily ingest volume and whether they require KMS key separation.
Nadia - CSM: They want VPC peering and a separate KMS key for embeddings only. Also asked for a short SLA for embed latency during business hours. They're GDPR scoped and prefer EU-only hosts for vector storage.
Eli - SE: Model details? If they're on `redwood/embed-sim-16k` we can offer a quantized variant or a reduced-dim config for prototypes to cut cost. I'll draft a config diff: set embedding.dim=512, batch.size=128, stream=false for bulk indexing.
billing-bot: billing_export_request created by Nadia for customer=pioneerml, export_type=per-route-token-cost, frequency=daily, format=csv
Jordi - AE: Proposed plan: 45-day embeddings-focused pilot (2 GPUs, NVMe cache, EU region), success metrics: sustained embed throughput >=1000 qps during business hours, median embed latency <500ms, <0.5% 429s. If hit, convert to Dedicated Reserved capacity + KMS add-on. I'll log opportunity in CRM with renewal_touchpoint.
Rita - Infra: I can provision an EU trial pool with NVMe attach and KMS key separation tomorrow afternoon. Will enable per-route billing hooks and a dashboard with embed-specific latency panels and a 429 alert at 0.5%. Need kickoff window and compliance checklist.
Nadia - CSM: Scheduling kickoff Fri 9am CET w/ Pioneer security + infra leads. Capturing feature asks: CSV export, EU-only vector store option, and a per-route billing UI in Console.
Eli - SE: I'll prepare a short playbook for embeddings pipelines: recommended `embedding.dim`, `batch.size`, cache warmup strategy, and a tiny repro script to simulate index rebuilds. Will include `curl` commands and a minimal Python client snippet.
Jordi - AE: I'll prepare a cost comparison (hosted vs dedicated) and an initial commercial proposal contingent on SLA and KMS terms. Note: finance requested a line item for NVMe caching ops.
Nadia - CSM: Action items:
- Nadia: Kickoff Fri 9am CET + send compliance checklist
- Rita: Provision EU-2 GPU trial + NVMe cache + separate KMS; attach dashboard/alerts
- Eli: Playbook + repro scripts before kickoff
- Jordi: CRM update, pricing comparison, and draft proposal
- Billing-bot: Enable daily per-route CSV exports for PioneerML

Will update thread with pilot pool link and first-day numbers. :rocket:
